title: Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans: Plans Held per Customer and per Vehicle
content:
**Clause.** Under the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, a customer may hold any number of maintenance plans, one per vehicle. Each plan's visits belong to its own vehicle and are never pooled or moved between a customer's plans. The one exception is a fleet substitution, where a fleet plan is moved from a retired fleet unit to its replacement vehicle.

There is no limit on the number of plans one customer may hold.

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| A customer holds plans on three different vehicles | Permitted: each vehicle carries its own plan |
| A customer asks to use visits from one plan on another vehicle's service | Not permitted: visits belong to their own vehicle |
| A customer asks to combine the unused visits of two plans | Not permitted: visits are never pooled |
| A fleet plan is moved from a retired fleet unit to its replacement vehicle | The fleet substitution exception |

Hypothetical illustration: a household with two cars, each carrying a plan with visits left, uses each plan only on the car it covers, however the remaining visits are spread between the two plans.
